# When --opt maps=true, Go-emitting platforms inject //line directives
# before each statement so the Go compiler attributes errors and stack
# traces back to the original SNGL source.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt=main=true --opt=maps=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# Inline //line directive present, pointing at the source file.
grep '//line app.sngl:' out/model.go

# Sanity: without maps the directive is absent.
sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out2 app.sngl
exists out2/model.go
! grep '//line app.sngl:' out2/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
    button(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
}
